# Bending energy, not knot count, predicts RWA breakdown

Across the replayed cat-state batch, the rotating-wave approximation holds
until the pulse's bending energy crosses a threshold; du-knot oscillations ride
the same signal. Knot count and crest sharpness predicted nothing on their own.
The missing piece in the failing solves was a level: adding the next transmon
level to the model is what removes the leakage.
